notes.title: 🌾 Farming - Enhance Your Experience, Invite and Reward! 🌾
notes.content:
Farming game has just launched its brand new Enhance System and Invitation Reward, aiming to bring you and your friends more enjoyment in the game! To build a more vibrant game world together, we sincerely invite you to invite 5 new players to join Farming.

In this event, the top 5 players who successfully synthesize a Lv.6 crop will receive the [b]Black Myth: Wukong Deluxe Edition CDK[/b] as the grand prize! ✨

[b]Event Rules:[/b]
1. You need to successfully invite 5 new players and bind the invitation code in order to participate in this event and claim the reward.
2. The top 5 players who enhance to Lv.6 crop will be the lucky winners!

Come and experience Farming's Enhance System, invite your friends to create wonderful gaming moments together! Opportunities are limited, welcome all players to actively participate! 💪🌾

notes.title: New Update: 10 Level-7 Skins Arrive!
notes.content:
[b]We are thrilled to introduce an exciting new Level-7 skin inspired by the legendary Chinese myth "Journey to the West." This skin features the iconic character Sun Wukong, bringing his unique style and charm to the game. Get ready to immerse yourself in this enchanting world![/b]
